notes: Parcoursup page: applies to French/European Bac holders; a Moroccan Bac holder applies via Études en France (see requirement manual_check). Tuition: the page states "Par année 178 euros" but this is the French/EU rate, not the differentiated rate for non-EU students, so no tuition fact is recorded here; the differentiated Licence fee stated on the Campus France Maroc page ("2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence") is a general figure for public Licence programmes, not this programme, so it is not recorded as this programme's tuition. A B2 French level is required; specific accepted certificates (TCF, DELF B2, DALF) are stated on the Campus France Maroc certifications page as mandatory for the Études en France application procedure.

note.fr: Candidats étrangers non titulaires d'un bac français/européen, non ressortissants UE/EEE/Suisse et résidant dans un pays Campus France : candidater via Études en France (Campus France), pas sur Parcoursup.
note.en: Foreign applicants without a French/European baccalaureate, non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals residing in a Campus France country: apply via Études en France (Campus France), not Parcoursup.
